My coworker says this has an off-by-one error. Fix it.

def first_n_squares(n):
    return [i*i for i in range(1, n+1)]

# first_n_squares(3) should return [1, 4, 9]

Fix the bug in this code:

def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c):
    # multiply by 5/9 and add 32
    return c * 9 / 5 + 32

Review this code for bugs. Be concise.

def add_item(item, bucket=[]):
    bucket.append(item)
    return bucket
